# Original jackpot recipient and promo winnings

The November 16 read-only production capture binds the original main/mini recipient function by its `pg_get_functiondef` MD5. The native proof executes that exact function before and after the original-source patch, over typed socket-only PostgreSQL stores.

The proof covers actual recipient seat/wallet/parking/refunding/redeeming/idempotency behavior, exact accepted investment fractions, cent conservation, source refusal, constructor rollback and a real busy-grant transaction. The W constructor is an explicitly named test-only sink; this is not proof of the separate 2x allocator, full main/mini jackpot bank allocation or production financial journal topology. Those have their own directly affected qualification. No production money is used.

The immutable accepted hand vector is the earning witness. No current balance, later gift, raw hand history retention, deposit or rakeback chooses the original winnings fraction. A parked promise holds no wallet funds and creates no fee phase.
